boundary: Released Flink2.2.1/JDK17, one worker, fresh JVM per run, identical 1M/5M runtime-generated INT source and rowwise blackhole sink. Two shared non-deterministic calls return INT/BIGINT/STRING; native keeps both transposes and one complete-row evaluator. Two warmups, three paired trials, alternating engines. SQL execution/planning/submission are timed; explanations, fixture setup and native consumption checks are outside timing. All completed trials are retained. No concurrent local compile/test workloads during timing. Standalone cost comparison, not a general composition speedup. New admission defaults off because it loses to stock.
